description: Use str.length() and str.charAt(i) inside a for loop to visit each character of a String from index 0 to the end.

steps.description: Store the six-character String "Hello!" in str on line 3.
Loop i from 0 while i < str.length() and call str.charAt(i) on line 6 to print each character at index i.

steps.answer: str.length() returns 6, and since String indices start at 0, i runs from 0 ('H') through 5 ('!').
steps.question: What does str.length() return for "Hello!", and what are the first and last indices passed to str.charAt(i)?

steps.description: See the first iteration at i = 0 fetch str.charAt(0) ('H') and print 'Give me a H'.

title: Looping Over Every Character in a String
